classification: Virtual thermodynamic transport closure. Conductance and diagonal gas mobilities are design values, not measured brick permeability, diffusivity, or kinetics.

source_basis.title: Onsager (1931), Reciprocal Relations in Irreversible Processes I
source_basis.scope: General thermodynamic flux-force formulation only. This source does not supply the selected diagonal coefficients, arithmetic face enthalpy, or real-brick validity.

definition: Positive left-to-right flow: F_i=mu_i,L/T_L-mu_i,R/T_R+hbar_i*(1/T_R-1/T_L); J_i=L_i*F_i; E=G*(T_L-T_R)+sum(hbar_i*J_i); hbar_i=(h_i,L+h_i,R)/2. Total entropy rate is G*(T_L-T_R)^2/(T_L*T_R)+sum(L_i*F_i^2). Equal opposite elemental and energy rates couple rigid cells with immobile solids.
